newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank Nova Scotia last to join Mondex.
newsitem.headline: Bank Nova Scotia last to join Mondex.

text.p: Bank of Nova Scotia said on Wednesday that it became the last of Canada's six big banks to sign on to the Mondex cash card system.

"Chip cards will no doubt play a significant role in payment systems of the future. Scotiabank has joined Mondex because we feel it's in our customers' best interests for us to keep abreast of all emerging chip market technologies," said Bob Lounsbury, Scotiabank's vice-president of card products and marketing.

Mondex Canada is part of Mondex International Limited, an independent global payments company owned by MasterCard International and 26 other major companies in North America, Europe, southeast Asia, Australia, and New Zealand.

The Mondex cash card is a plastic card with a computer chip embedded in it that allows its user to transfer electronic money from a corresponding bank account for payments to merchants or other Mondex cash card users.
Mondex began a limited test of its smart card technology in Guelph, Ontario in February and has said it will start rolling out the cards across Canada in 1998.
